The extracted text is malformed, so I will split it into lines, remove duplicate titles, and rejoin only the title values with commas.

```python
lines = [line.strip() for line in movie_recommendations_note['content'].splitlines() if line.strip()]
title_values = [line.split(':', 1)[0].strip() for line in lines if line.startswith('-') or line.startswith('#')]
unique_title_values = sorted(title_values, key=lambda title: title.strip())
reply_text = ','.join(unique_title_values)
print(reply_text)
```
